about_the_game:
AstroCore Mining is a colony simulation sandbox set in the depths of space. Manage a mining colony on asteroids, extract valuable resources, and meet corporate quotas or face dire consequences.

But this is not just about mining. Your colony functions like a nation, and you are its leader.

Factions at play: Balance the competing interests of Business (CEO directives and corporate guilds), Military (guards protecting the colony), and Workers (who may riot if neglected). Each faction pushes its own agenda, and your choices determine who holds power.

Multiple paths of rule: Govern through democratic councils, corporate oligarchy, or authoritarian CEO regimes. Each leadership style reshapes both internal politics and external relations.

Diplomacy in deep space: Pirates and rival corporations are more than enemies; they are political actors. Negotiate, ally, bribe, or confront them to secure your colony’s future.

Political survival over combat: Violence exists, but persuasion, negotiation, and the management of factions define your success as a leader.

Social order: Worker unrest, riots, and public welfare (from hospital beds to security forces) remind you that leadership is about more than resource extraction.

Meanwhile, layout planning remains essential. Design underground bases, optimize resource management, and maintain the fragile balance between survival and efficiency. Command ships, defend against raids, and attach thrusters to asteroids to advance to the next system.

Will you lead your people to prosperity, oppression, or collapse under the weight of deep-space capitalism? Lead not just a colony, but the future of a nation. Will it be run by humans, robots, or both?

Capitalism Among the Stars

With the new Political Economy Update, Astrocore Mining goes beyond survival and resource extraction. As a middle manager in charge of a corporate colony, you face faction conflicts, worker riots, and interstellar diplomacy. Choose your ruling style such as democratic or authoritarian, and balance CEO pressure against worker survival. Every policy you enact, every quota you enforce, and every deal you strike determines whether your company rises as a capitalist powerhouse or collapses under chaos.

The game is under development. Visuals does not represent end-quality of the game.

Build, Expand, and Exploit

  • Asteroid Colonization: Transform lifeless rock into a thriving mining operation. Tunnel through asteroids, construct underground facilities, and optimize your colony’s layout for efficiency.

  • Dynamic Resource System: Extract rare minerals, refine resources, and maintain a steady supply chain to meet corporate demands.

  • Survival & Population Management: Keep your colonists alive in the cold void of space. Oxygen, food, power, and morale; every detail matters in maintaining a stable workforce.

  • Procedural Asteroid Generation: Each system presents new challenges with unique asteroid compositions and environmental hazards.

The game is under development. Visuals does not represent end-quality of the game.

Space is Not Empty. It's Dangerous.

  • Hostile Encounters: Defend your operation against pirate raids, corporate rivals, and the unpredictable dangers of deep space.

  • Attack Ships and Defense: Deploy defenses to protect your assets or raid enemies with attack ships for valuable loot.

  • Asteroid Modification: There's no end to expansion. Attach thrusters to asteroids and guide them to new star systems for fresh mining opportunities.

The game is under development. Visuals does not represent end-quality of the game.

Total Control, Real Consequences

  • Layout Planning & Automation: Give direct orders to colonists, manage work schedules, and let AI-driven decisions shape the fate of your workforce.

  • Corporate Quotas & Survival Strategy: The company demands results. If you fail to meet expectations, your career and your life are over.

  • Morality vs. Efficiency: Will you care for your workers, or push them to the brink for maximum productivity? The fate of your colony rests in your hands.


Are You Ready to Survive the Final Frontier?

Astrocore Mining challenges you to master the brutal balance between survival, strategy, and sacrifice. Expand your empire, optimize resource management, push your workforce to the edge, and decide how far you'll go to ensure profit... because in space, nobody cares if you scream.

Wishlist now and prepare for launch!
